title: एकादशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 111 · Garuda and the ascetic Shandili

summary.en: On the mountain they are fed by the Brahmin ascetic Shandili, and Garuda, thinking to carry her off to the world of Brahma, finds his wings burnt off by her power. He begs her forgiveness, she restores his wings, and the two travellers resume their search.
summary.kn: ಪರ್ವತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ತಪಸ್ವಿನಿ ಶಾಂಡಿಲಿ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಊಟ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ಅವಳನ್ನು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಒಯ್ಯಲು ಯೋಚಿಸಿದ ಗರುಡನ ರೆಕ್ಕೆಗಳು ಅವಳ ಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಸುಟ್ಟುಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಅವನು ಕ್ಷಮೆ ಬೇಡುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅವಳು ರೆಕ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮರಳಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: पर्वत पर ब्राह्मणी तपस्विनी शाण्डिली उन्हें भोजन कराती हैं, और उन्हें ब्रह्मलोक ले जाने का विचार करने वाले गरुड़ के पंख उनकी शक्ति से जल जाते हैं। वे क्षमा माँगते हैं, वे पंख लौटा देती हैं, और दोनों यात्री फिर खोज आरम्भ करते हैं।
summary.te: పర్వతంపై బ్రాహ్మణ తాపసి శాండిలి వారికి భోజనం పెడుతుంది; ఆమెను బ్రహ్మలోకానికి తీసుకువెళ్లాలని ఆలోచించిన గరుడుని రెక్కలు ఆమె శక్తితో కాలిపోతాయి. అతడు క్షమించమని వేడుకుంటాడు, ఆమె రెక్కలను తిరిగి ఇస్తుంది, ఇద్దరూ వెతుకులాట కొనసాగిస్తారు.
summary.ta: மலையில் அந்தணத் தவசி ஶாண்டிலி அவர்களுக்கு உணவளிக்க, அவளை ப்ரஹ்மலோகத்துக்குச் சுமந்து செல்ல நினைத்த கருடனின் சிறகுகள் அவள் ஆற்றலால் எரிந்துவிடுகின்றன. அவன் மன்னிப்பு வேண்ட, அவள் சிறகுகளை மீட்டுத் தர, இருவரும் தேடலைத் தொடர்கிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: പർവ്വതത്തിൽവെച്ച് ബ്രാഹ്മണതപസ്വിനിയായ ശാണ്ഡിലി അവർക്ക് ഭക്ഷണം നൽകുന്നു; ബ്രഹ്മലോകത്തേക്ക് അവളെ കൊണ്ടുപോകാൻ ഗരുഡൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു, എന്നാൽ അവളുടെ ശക്തിയാൽ ചിറകുകൾ കത്തിപ്പോകുന്നതായി അദ്ദേഹം കാണുന്നു. മാപ്പ് യാചിക്കുന്ന അദ്ദേഹത്തിന് അവൾ ചിറകുകൾ തിരിച്ചുനൽകുന്നു; ഇരുവരും അന്വേഷണം തുടരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.111; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
ऋषभस्य ततः शृङ्गे निपत्य द्विजपक्षिणौ ।
शाण्डिलीं ब्राह्मणीं तत्र ददृशाते तपोन्विताम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the bird and the brahmin alighted on the peak of Rishabha and saw there the ascetic brahmin woman Shandili.

verses.text:
अभिवाद्य सुपर्णस्तु गालवश्चाभिपूज्य ताम् ।
तया च स्वागतेनोक्तौ विष्टरे संनिषीदतुः ॥

meaning.en: Suparna and Galava greeted and honored her, and, welcomed by her, they sat down on seats.

verses.text:
सिद्धमन्नं तया क्षिप्रं बलिमन्त्रोपबृंहितम् ।
भुक्त्वा तृप्तावुभौ भूमौ सुप्तौ तावन्नमोहितौ ॥

meaning.en: She quickly prepared food, blessed with the mantras of the offering. Having eaten and been satisfied, the two, stupefied by the meal, lay down on the ground and slept.

verses.text:
मुहूर्तात्प्रतिबुद्धस्तु सुपर्णो गमनेप्सया ।
अथ भ्रष्टतनूजाङ्गमात्मानं ददृशे खगः ॥

meaning.en: After a moment Suparna woke, wanting to go, and the bird saw that his own body had lost its wings and limbs.

verses.text:
मांसपिण्डोपमोऽभूत्स मुखपादान्वितः खगः ।
गालवस्तं तथा दृष्ट्वा विषण्णः पर्यपृच्छत ॥

meaning.en: He had become like a lump of flesh with only a head and feet. Seeing him so, Galava was dismayed and asked him.

verses.text:
किमिदं भवता प्राप्तमिहागमनजं फलम् ।
वासोऽयमिह कालं तु कियन्तं नौ भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: 'What is this that you have got as the fruit of coming here? How long will our stay here last?

verses.text:
किं नु ते मनसा ध्यातमशुभं धर्मदूषणम् ।
न ह्ययं भवतः स्वल्पो व्यभिचारो भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Did you think some evil thought in your mind, one that corrupts Dharma? For this fault of yours cannot be a small one.'

verses.text:
सुपर्णोऽथाब्रवीद्विप्रं प्रध्यातं वै मया द्विज ।
इमां सिद्धामितो नेतुं तत्र यत्र प्रजापतिः ॥

meaning.en: Suparna replied to the brahmin, 'Yes, brahmin, I did think of taking this perfected woman from here to where Prajapati is,

verses.text:
यत्र देवो महादेवो यत्र विष्णुः सनातनः ।
यत्र धर्मश्च यज्ञश्च तत्रेयं निवसेदिति ॥

meaning.en: where the god Mahadeva is, where eternal Vishnu is, where Dharma and sacrifice are: that she should live there.

verses.text:
सोऽहं भगवतीं याचे प्रणतः प्रियकाम्यया ।
मयैतन्नाम प्रध्यातं मनसा शोचता किल ॥

meaning.en: So, bowed down, I beg the blessed lady, wishing to please her. That is what I thought in my mind, I who was grieving.

verses.text:
तदेवं बहुमानात्ते मयेहानीप्सितं कृतम् ।
सुकृतं दुष्कृतं वा त्वं माहात्म्यात्क्षन्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: So out of regard for you, I did this unwanted thing here. Whether it be good or ill, in your greatness you should forgive it.'

verses.text:
सा तौ तदाब्रवीत्तुष्टा पतगेन्द्रद्विजर्षभौ ।
न भेतव्यं सुपर्णोऽसि सुपर्ण त्यज संभ्रमम् ॥

meaning.en: Pleased, she then said to the two, the king of birds and the bull of brahmin sages, 'Do not be afraid. You are Suparna; give up your agitation, Suparna.

verses.text:
निन्दितास्मि त्वया वत्स न च निन्दां क्षमाम्यहम् ।
लोकेभ्यः स परिभ्रश्येद्यो मां निन्देत पापकृत् ॥

meaning.en: I have been slighted by you, child, and I do not forgive slights. Whoever sinfully slights me falls from all the worlds.

verses.text:
हीनयालक्षणैः सर्वैस्तथानिन्दितया मया ।
आचारं प्रतिगृह्णन्त्या सिद्धिः प्राप्तेयमुत्तमा ॥

meaning.en: Though I lack all the marks of fortune and am despised, I took up good conduct, and by it I attained this highest perfection.

verses.text:
आचाराल्लभते धर्ममाचाराल्लभते धनम् ।
आचाराच्छ्रियमाप्नोति आचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: By good conduct one gains Dharma, by conduct one gains wealth, by conduct one attains prosperity, and conduct destroys bad marks.

verses.text:
तदायुष्मन्खगपते यथेष्टं गम्यतामितः ।
न च ते गर्हणीयापि गर्हितव्याः स्त्रियः क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: So, long-lived lord of birds, go from here as you wish. And never should women, even blameworthy ones, be blamed.

verses.text:
भवितासि यथापूर्वं बलवीर्यसमन्वितः ।
बभूवतुस्ततस्तस्य पक्षौ द्रविणवत्तरौ ॥

meaning.en: You will be as before, endowed with strength and valor.' Then his two wings grew back, richer than before.

verses.text:
अनुज्ञातश्च शाण्डिल्या यथागतमुपागमत् ।
नैव चासादयामास तथारूपांस्तुरंगमान् ॥

meaning.en: With Shandili's leave he returned the way he had come, but he did not find horses of that description.

verses.text:
विश्वामित्रोऽथ तं दृष्ट्वा गालवं चाध्वनि स्थितम् ।
उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठो वैनतेयस्य संनिधौ ॥

meaning.en: Then Vishvamitra, best of speakers, saw Galava standing on the road, in the presence of Vinata's son, and said:

verses.text:
यस्त्वया स्वयमेवार्थः प्रतिज्ञातो मम द्विज ।
तस्य कालोऽपवर्गस्य यथा वा मन्यते भवान् ॥

meaning.en: 'The matter you yourself promised me, brahmin, the time for its fulfilment is now, or as you see fit.

verses.text:
प्रतीक्षिष्याम्यहं कालमेतावन्तं तथा परम् ।
यथा संसिध्यते विप्र स मार्गस्तु निशम्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: I shall wait this long, and a little more, until it is accomplished. Listen, brahmin, to the way.'

verses.text:
सुपर्णोऽथाब्रवीद्दीनं गालवं भृशदुःखितम् ।
प्रत्यक्षं खल्विदानीं मे विश्वामित्रो यदुक्तवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Suparna said to Galava, who was wretched and deeply grieved, 'I have now heard with my own ears what Vishvamitra has said.

verses.text:
तदागच्छ द्विजश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रयिष्याव गालव ।
नादत्त्वा गुरवे शक्यं कृत्स्नमर्थं त्वयासितुम् ॥

meaning.en: So come, best of brahmins, Galava, let us consult. You cannot rest without giving your teacher the whole fee.'
